data.name: Hamimah
data.gender_notes: Hamimah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A woman with a sweet fragrance that spreads joy and happiness. The name Hamimah carries the meaning “Sweet Smell” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Hamimah usually hope their child will grow to embody sweet smell and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the sweetness and joy that comes from the remembrance of Allah
data.etymology: Hamimah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Sweet Smell.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hamimah total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: حميمة
in_arabic.meaning: اسم حميمة يعني الحميمية و القرب و الصداقة الحميمة
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم حميمة مشتق من الجذر العربي حمم و يعني الحميمية و القرب و الصداقة الحميمة. ورد ذكر هذا الاسم في القرآن الكريم في سياق الحديث عن علاقة الأخوة و الصداقة بين المسلمين. يعتبر اسم حميمة من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني جميلة و عميقة في الثقافة الإسلامية و تعكس قيمة الحميمية و القرب بين الناس.

in_urdu.name: حمیمہ
in_urdu.meaning: حمیمہ نام کا مطلب ہے قربت، دوستي اور خلوص
in_urdu.long_meaning: حمیمہ نام عربی جڑ حمم سے ماخوذ ہے اور قربت، دوستي اور خلوص کے معنی رکھتا ہے۔ یہ نام جنوبی ایشیا میں مسلمانوں کے ذریعہ روایتی اور معاصر طور پر استعمال کیا جاتا ہے۔ اسلامی تقالید میں، یہ نام بھائی چارے اور دوستي کے اہمیت کو ظاہر کرتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: हमीमा
in_hindi.meaning: हमीमा नाम का अर्थ है निकटता, मित्रता और सच्चाई
in_hindi.long_meaning: हमीमा नाम की उत्पत्ति अरबी मूल से हुई है और इसका अर्थ निकटता, मित्रता और सच्चाई है। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, यह नाम पारंपरिक और आधुनिक दोनों संदर्भों में प्रयोग किया जाता है। इस्लामी परंपरा में, यह नाम भाईचारे और मित्रता के महत्व को दर्शाता है।

in_pashto.name: حميمه
in_pashto.meaning: حميمه نوم د قربت، دوستۍ او رښتینوالي معنی لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: حميمه نوم د عربي جڑ حمم څخه اخیستل شوی دی او د قربت، دوستۍ او رښتینوالي معنی لري. په افغانستان او پښتونستان کې، دا نوم دودیز او معاصر په مسلمو ټولنو کې کارول کیږي. دا نوم د ورورګلو او دوستۍ د ارزښتونو څرګندونه کوي.

in_english.name: Hamimah
in_english.meaning: Hamimah means intimacy, closeness, and sincere friendship
in_english.long_meaning: The name Hamimah originates from the Arabic root 'ḥ-m-m' which conveys the meanings of intimacy, closeness, and sincere friendship. This name is mentioned in the Quranic context of brotherhood and friendship among Muslims. In Islamic tradition, Hamimah symbolizes the value of close relationships and sincerity among people. It is used across various Muslim cultures, reflecting the universal importance of genuine bonds and companionship.

data.cultural_impact: The name Hamimah holds a beautiful cultural significance in the Arab world, especially amongst the Arabic-speaking Muslim population. This name is often associated with suffering, patience, and resilience – the qualities of a woman who carries an unwavering sweetness within herself, even amidst adversity. In Arabic folklore, Hamimah is also known as the name of a strong and resourceful woman who, despite facing hardships, remains optimistic and patient. In the Arabic language, hamimah translates to "sweet scent," symbolizing the perpetual joy and positivity emanating from an embodiment of this name, brightening up the lives of those around them.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Hamimah carries an inspiring and uplifting meaning that resonates with the human spirit. It reminds us to radiate joy and positivity, no matter the circumstances we encounter. In Islamic teachings, the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) emphasized the importance of maintaining a happy disposition, for a cheerful heart is more likely to attract blessings and divine guidance. Therefore, the name Hamimah serves as an encouragement for us to carry the sweetness of our faith within us, allowing our spiritual light to guide and uplift those around us, fostering harmony and understanding among all people.
